classification.difficultyReason: Translate the two bearings into triangle angles and use an opposite pair for two distances.

content.prompt:
$M$ is 50km north of $O$. The bearing of $N$ from $M$ is $108^\circ$ and from $O$ it is $061^\circ$.
Answer the following questions to the nearest kilometre.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 4, diagram below parts a and b
spec.description: Blue triangle MON with M vertically above O and N to the right between their heights. Dark north arrow above M carries upright N; triangle vertex labels are italic. Exterior clockwise bearing arc at M is 108 degrees; interior arc at O is 61 degrees. No side length is printed.
spec.mathematics: MO vertical; bearing MN=108 degrees; bearing ON=061 degrees. Preserve both distinct N labels. Triangle strokes #014D85; other marks dark.

children.prompt: What is the distance between $M$ and $N$?
